corrections: Earlier simple common-budget claims are superseded: Elites now receive an explicit 25% HP / 8% damage premium after tier scaling, rounded to integer percentages.
HP-derived enemy healing and Barrier also rise under the existing conversion; this is not HP-only durability.
A higher Tier I baseline adds ten HP and three damage percentage points at EVERY tier; it is not a multiplicative 10% global increase.
Available client Campaign save positions are old-route observations, not independent measured matches, current-rules tests, or complete reward histories.
evaluationScope: All thirty Ascendancies, all ten starts and freely mixed builds reviewed statically. I-III is starter-only; IV-VII, VIII-X and XI-XII need separate field evidence. Opening 1-3, extended 6-10 and beyond ten own turns remain unmeasured. Arena stays at 1000HP with existing seat/clock/AI policy. New Strike cards are available to mixed decks; no measured grade changes or A-tier parity claim.

mixedBuilds.setup: More deliberate acquisition; still depends on offers and resource costs. Five-lane branching increases visible choices, not guaranteed pieces. Twelve-tier route offers fewer ordinary stops; no guarantee of mixed-engine completion. Additional Elite rewards may offset fewer ordinary stops, but mixed-engine acquisition is not guaranteed. Rift10% per eligible ordinary slot broadens future options, with25% lower fight shards; Gilded reverses that trade with40% extra fight shards and0% ordinary foreign chance. No particular foreign synergy guaranteed. 0.207 XII provides five late upgrades/removals; this can remove unwanted status cards but cannot guarantee all engine pieces or unlimited cleanup. 0.208 leaves setup costs and rarity unchanged; Heart provenance only. Knife caps retain card availability and costs. 0.209: acquired Recall3Mana/Consume instead of2Mana/15knife cap. Additional Campaign spending can help assemble freely mixed pieces; offers/shop access still constrain setup. Latest realm revision replaces five finale refinements with three and eleven Gifts with five. Late recipe completion is less assured; one cleanup remains directly before Drago. Additional native formations and Recurring Nightmares may alter off-class engine consistency; generated cards can also fuel Consume/Created engines. No specific rare guaranteed.
mixedBuilds.recovery: Foreign recovery cards can be selected; no sustain increase established. Meeting points can force a fight when recovery is needed; track this separately by tier. Separate usual Warden recovery from companion rebuild, card consistency and successive matchup disruption. Halved finale recovery requires direct survival/rebuild evidence; do not assume foreign healing solves every matchup. Draw/Barrier/phase choice can support recovery; effectiveness remains unmeasured. No shrine healing. Draw consistency may improve after removal; unmeasured. Qualifying recurring card Barrier now gets Warded125%, before Brittle; no trait/status/companion/totem bonus. Any acquired Echo is limited15actualBarrier/copy/turn; no build-wide Barrier ceiling. Echo/PatientWall/other Barrier Aura values unchanged; no universal Barrier ceiling inferred. Purchased recovery/removal opportunities improve conditionally; no free automatic healing change. New native boss counters require field evidence; no inferred sustain parity. Healthy minions can spread lightning but low-HP losses still Overflow. Cleansing/HP recovery can limit Fate. Targeted Egg removal denies enemy support. These are inferred options, not player-intent observations.
mixedBuilds.rareReliance: Build-dependent; treasure gives three rares, not a specific rare.
